learnings.question: In memory research conducted by Hermann Ebbinghaus in the 1880s, approximately what percentage of learned information is forgotten within 24 hours without active recall?
learnings.learning: Research conducted by Hermann Ebbinghaus in the 1880s demonstrated that humans forget approximately 80% of what they learn within 24 hours unless they actively force themselves to recall it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: When analyzing word frequency in the Quran, approximately what percentage of the text do the top 20 most frequent words actually account for?
learnings.learning: Contrary to expectations based on the Pareto Principle (80/20 rule), mastering the top 20 most frequent words in the Quran accounts for only about 20.83% of the total text.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: In PCI Express (PCIe) power management, what is the primary trade-off when transitioning a device into deeper power-saving states?
options: Energy savings increase, but the time required to wake up and resume operation increases
Energy savings increase, and the time required to wake up and resume operation decreases
Energy savings decrease, but the time required to wake up and resume operation decreases
Energy savings remain constant, but data transmission bandwidth is doubled
learnings.learning: PCIe power management balances energy efficiency and system responsiveness across a spectrum of operational states. As a PCIe device transitions into deeper power-saving states, it achieves greater energy savings at the cost of an increased delay to wake up and resume full activity.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic conceptual terms, what is the key distinction between Qada’ and Qadr?
options: Qada’ is Allah's eternal, unchangeable register, whereas Qadr refers specifically to individual human supplications.
Qada’ represents the actual occurrence of events that can be altered by supplication, whereas Qadr is Allah's complete, preordained plan.
Qada’ refers exclusively to disasters and hardships, whereas Qadr represents financial prosperity and success.
Qada’ represents free will existing entirely outside divine permission, whereas Qadr refers to protection granted by angels.
learnings.learning: Qada’ refers to the actual unfolding of events in life that can be influenced by actions and supplication (Dua), while Qadr is Allah’s eternal, preordained plan that encompasses all events and changes within His complete knowledge.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Which Scrum artifact is used to visualize the progress of a Sprint and display remaining work?
learnings.learning: A Burndown Chart is a key Scrum artifact that visualizes the progress of a Sprint and shows remaining work to help track if the team is on schedule.
